nodes.label: KineticGraph-Vectra Hybrid RAG
nodes.rationale: Combines vector semantic similarity, graph relationship traversal, and BM25 lexical lookup, merged via Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

nodes.label: Evidence-First Knowledge Retrieval
nodes.rationale: Favor transparent reasoning over opaque sophistication and grounded answers over plausible-looking completeness.

nodes.label: Architectural North Star
nodes.rationale: Retrieve verified evidence first. Explain how it was found. Generate only what the evidence supports.

nodes.label: Retrieval Before Generation
nodes.rationale: Preferred workflow: understand query → retrieve → traverse → fuse → rerank → generate from evidence. Generation must not compensate for missing context.

nodes.label: Faithfulness Over Completeness
nodes.rationale: Answer only supported portions; grounding critic may remove claims but never rewrite, add facts, or invent citations; synthesis at temperature 0.0.

nodes.label: Conditional Recovery Mechanisms
nodes.rationale: Query expansion, decomposition, or HyDE run only when normal retrieval is weak; recovery occurs before RRF.

nodes.label: Decision Gate for New Features
nodes.rationale: Features require measured failure address, metric expectations, observability, rollback, and benchmark proof before becoming defaults.

nodes.label: Vector and Graph Store Separation
nodes.rationale: ChromaDB owns embeddings; Neo4j owns entities/relationships/topology; embeddings should not be duplicated into Neo4j without measured reason.

nodes.label: Benchmark Audit Sidecar v1.1.0-draft
nodes.rationale: Draft audit is intentionally not accepted for evaluation to prevent stale reference answers being mistaken for retrieval failures.

nodes.label: Neo4j HTTP Healthcheck Fix
nodes.rationale: Replaced failing neo4j status command with HTTP spider on port 7474 and start_period 40s.

nodes.label: OpenResearch-Inspired Ratchet Policy
nodes.rationale: Each candidate changes one attributable lever; keep only when weighted score improves without material single-metric regression.

nodes.label: Evaluation Mode Profiles
nodes.rationale: Profiles are evaluation-only and never change production defaults; hybrid_lexical is not dedicated Vectorless.

nodes.label: Bounded Traversal-Depth Sweep
nodes.rationale: Issue #44 ablation over max_hops 1/2/3; hop 2 remains rollback; promotion requires human review.

nodes.label: LiteParse Server Integration
nodes.rationale: Local layout-aware PDF parsing to Markdown via PDFium+OCR to improve GraphRAG structural accuracy without cloud API costs.

nodes.label: OpenAI Embedding API Key Requirement
nodes.rationale: Documents cannot be embedded into ChromaDB without a valid OpenAI key (sk-); Google AIzaSy keys cause 401 failures.

nodes.label: Context Recall Coverage Problem
nodes.rationale: Precision 1.0 with recall 0.3476 indicates coverage deficit, not over-retrieval; first remediation is route and facet coverage.

nodes.label: Silent Mode Downgrade
nodes.rationale: Intent router can replace requested HYBRID with vector-only or graph-only, dropping a necessary channel before fusion.

nodes.label: Stale Score Provenance
nodes.rationale: Persisted evaluation report predates current 20-row benchmark and v3 workflow; unsuitable for current architecture attribution.

nodes.label: Exact-Term Modality Gap
nodes.rationale: Exact identifiers lack default BM25 channel because lexical fusion is disabled by default.

nodes.label: Neo4j Credential Policy
nodes.rationale: No shipped password; fails closed when NEO4J_PASSWORD absent; rotate historical committed development password.

nodes.label: Generated Cypher Validation
nodes.rationale: LLM Cypher treated as untrusted; only single read-only MATCH/OPTIONAL MATCH with RETURN accepted; defense in depth alongside read-only Neo4j account.

nodes.label: Adaptive Routing
nodes.rationale: Confidence-aware reversible execution-plan router that honors caller mode, retains Hybrid for compound/low-confidence queries, and avoids silent single-channel downgrades; rejected Always-Hybrid, LLM-only routing, and HyDE-before-routing.

nodes.label: Adaptive Chunking
nodes.rationale: Structural-first versioned chunk policy replaces one-size-fits-all recursive chunks so headings, tables, and image/caption relationships are preserved; rejected whole-document embeds, semantic-only chunking, and Neo4j embedding storage by default.

nodes.label: Retrieval Orchestration
nodes.rationale: Provenance-preserving multi-stage pipeline because RRF alone cannot prove evidence completeness; rejected fuse-then-generate, graph-centrality dominance, and black-box fusion.

nodes.label: Verification Framework
nodes.rationale: Return only citation-validated atomic claims with a filter-only grounding critic; faithfulness must be structural rather than model self-rating.

nodes.label: Kinetic Score
nodes.rationale: Versioned 0-100 evidence-confidence composite; not a guarantee of factual correctness and must never override refusal.

nodes.label: Kinetic-V 2.0
nodes.rationale: Evolves Kinegraph into an evidence-first retrieval platform with explicit decisions, confidence, and verification at every boundary.

nodes.label: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)
nodes.rationale: Merges incompatible ChromaDB and Neo4j scores by rank: RRF(d)=sum 1/(k+rank_m(d)).

nodes.label: Dual-Store Integration (Neo4j + ChromaDB)
nodes.rationale: Keep graph storage (Neo4j) and vector storage (ChromaDB) decoupled; do not use Neo4j native vector index.
